sql: UPDATE flights SET started_at='2024-01-01 08:00:00', stopped_at=NULL, ended_at=NULL, paused_seconds=0 WHERE id={flight}
UPDATE flights SET scheduled_flight_id=(SELECT id FROM scheduled_flights WHERE scheduled_date=date('now') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) WHERE id={flight}
UPDATE scheduled_flights SET status='in_progress' WHERE id=(SELECT scheduled_flight_id FROM flights WHERE id={flight})
